newsitem.title: USA: Avondale to exchange note for Oneita stake.
newsitem.headline: Avondale to exchange note for Oneita stake.

text.p: Avondale Mills Inc said Monday it agreed to exchange a $7.5 million note issued by Oneita Industries Inc for 2.27 million Oneita common shares.

The deal, which is expected to close on August 27, will give the Sylacauga, Ala.,-based textile company a 24.8 percent stake in Oneita, Avondale said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Avondale said the purpose of the exchange is to improve the financial condition of Oneita, a Charleston, S.C., maker of T-shirts and fleecewear.
